neighbours.label: the Chinese particle 的 as its own separate token, joining a describer (adjective, noun or verb clause) to a following noun; it stays dark where 的 is glued to a very common neighbour (我的, 好的, 大的, 的人, 的问题, 的学生), in 的确, and for sentence-final 的
neighbours.short: stand-alone 的 linking a modifier to its noun
